annotations.title: Coast Guard documentation fees for a financed boat

description: Adds up the Coast Guard NVDC fees (46 CFR 67.550) to document a financed recreational boat: Abstract of Title, initial certificate or exchange into your name for 1 to 5 years, bill of sale and preferred mortgage recording by page count, and a certified copy for the lender, plus the full NVDC fee table.

already_documented.description: true (default) if the boat is already documented, so the certificate is exchanged into your name ($84.00); false if it has never been documented (initial certificate, $133.00).

bill_of_sale_pages.description: Pages of the bill of sale to record at $8.00 a page; 0 if none is filed. Default 2 (an assumption; count your own).

mortgage_pages.description: Pages of the preferred mortgage to record at $4.00 a page; 0 if not financed. Default 12 (an assumption; count your own).

years.description: Years the recreational endorsement runs, 1 to 5 ($26.00 for each year past the first). Default 5.

name: estimate_uscg_documentation_fees
title: Coast Guard documentation fees for a financed boat
